credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Glass jar containing Lapis Lazuli pigment powder (blue) affixed with a handwritten label by Georgia O'Keeffe.  Handwritten in black ink, on a faded gummed paper label with a red border, are the words: Lapis Lazuli - Asolo. The black metal lid has abrasions and scratches and the jar of pigment is 1/2 full.

title: Paint Pigment, Lapis Lazuli
